# Camouflare 1.3.2

> Draft for maintainer review. Remove this note before publishing the GitHub Release.

Camouflare 1.3.2 is a patch release that fixes a browser-pool failure mode in which one
browser dying took the pool down with it under concurrent load, plus three related
resource and error-handling defects found in the same audit.

## What changed

- Camoufox launches are serialized. Camoufox resolves its virtual display by mutating the
  shared process environment from a worker thread and by reading `/tmp` lock files without
  a lock of its own, so two overlapping launches handed a single Xvfb to two Firefox
  processes and the first of the pair to exit or fail killed the display under the other.
- The pool checks browser liveness before reserving a context slot. A dead browser was
  previously only discovered when a request failed on it, so every request that arrived
  first was handed the same dead browser, turning one browser death into one failure per
  in-flight request.
- A browser whose physical close fails is retried on a later acquisition, bounded and
  backed off, instead of only at shutdown. A wedged browser process previously survived
  for the life of the service while its slot kept `closing_slots` above zero.
- A renderer crash is reported as a browser transport failure rather than an internal
  error, so a crashed GET can use the direct HTTP fallback and is reported as retryable,
  and a crashed POST reports an uncertain outcome.
- A single waiting request starts at most one browser launch, instead of growing the pool
  toward `POOL_MAX_BROWSERS` on every unrelated wake-up during an in-flight launch.

## Upgrading

No configuration changes are required. Two response details change for the better:
a navigation that fails on a renderer crash now returns `errorCode`
`BROWSER_TRANSPORT_CLOSED` instead of `INTERNAL_ERROR`, and such a failed `request.post`
now reports `requestOutcomeUnknown: true`, which is the honest answer for a crash that
cannot establish whether the request was delivered. Clients keying off either field
should review that change.

## Container image

The immutable release image is available for Linux `amd64` and `arm64`:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/mehmetcansahin/camouflare:1.3.2
```

See the
[changelog](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v1.3.2/CHANGELOG.md#132---2026-08-25)
for the complete entry and the
[deployment guide](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v1.3.2/docs/deployment.md)
for production constraints and rollback guidance.
